description:
FILED s541a (Opus agent, 2026-11-16) from the CPAN board's RUN-PHASE measurement (#4791; docs/cpan-runtime-comparison-s541.md, the per-file table baselines/board-runtime-s541.tsv, the instrument tools/board-timing.pl --run).  Code c1fe4930 (MAIN-READY-97); timings on a quiet box (heavy.sh bench, best of 3, load < 2), scratch in the s541a worktree scratch/s541a/.

WHAT: scratch/s541a/dev/surrogate-eval.pl --
  no warnings; my $s = "\x{D800}";
  my $r1 = eval "'$s' =~ /x/; 1";  my $r2 = eval "2 + 2";  my $r3 = eval "3 + 3";
perl 5.40.3: '1 ok' / '2: 4' / '3: 6'.  pcl (c1fe4930): eval 1 dies ':utf-8 stream encoding error on', eval 2 dies "PCL: quote-like literal: 'PCL-EVAL-WIR is not implemented", eval 3 dies "the eval server ... speaks 'PCL-EVAL-WIRE 2' but the request began 'E 2': the runtime and pl2cl come from different PCL trees" -- the wire is out of step for the rest of the process; plus a spurious 'Wide character in print at unknown line 0.' on stderr.

WHERE IT BITES: Pod::Simple::BlackBox (every Pod::Simple program) builds three regexes at load with my_qr('\p{IsCs}', "\x{D800}") etc.: perl gives qr's, PCL gives '' for $cs_re, $cn_re, $rare_blocks_re (scratch/s541a/dev/evalprobe2.pl: perl cs=[(?^:\p{IsCs})] cn=[(?^:\p{IsCn})] ok=[...]; pcl cs=[] cn=[] ok=[]), and any LATER string eval of such a program that misses the eval cache dies.  The board's Pod-Simple files pass anyway (nothing they assert reaches it), which is how it stayed unseen.

PERF SIDE (#5062): the failed evals are never cached, so every Pod-Simple test file starts the transpile server (~0.13 s) in its run.

FIX AREA: the request writer (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp p-transpile-string / its wire writer) must not die part-way -- encode the text before writing (a surrogate is not UTF-8: send it escaped, or refuse the eval with a perl-shaped error BEFORE a byte is written) and resynchronise / restart the server on any write error.  Guard: the three evals above in one Pl/t row (perl's output).
subject: CORRECTNESS: a string eval whose TEXT holds a lone surrogate (U+D800) poisons the pl2cl eval server's wire -- the request dies part-way on its UTF-8 encoding and EVERY later uncached string eval of the process fails; Pod::Simple::BlackBox's load (my_qr('\p{IsCs}', "\x{D800}")) leaves $cs_re / $cn_re / $rare_blocks_re empty
